headline: Global outage: Facebook desktop version unavailable for many users
summary: Users in Bangladesh and worldwide are facing login issues and feed errors as the platform experiences a sudden technical glitch.
details: Facebook's desktop version has experienced a sudden outage, leaving many users unable to access the site. The issue began around 1:40 PM on Sunday, July 19, affecting users in Bangladesh and across the globe.

Many users reported being unable to log in, slow loading times, and feeds that fail to update. Some encountered a message stating, 'Account Temporarily Unavailable' due to a site issue, urging them to try again in a few minutes.

According to Downdetector, reports of service disruptions spiked shortly after 1:30 PM. The Manchester Evening News also noted a significant increase in searches for 'Facebook down' starting around 9 AM local time.
Data shows that approximately 50% of affected users struggled to access the website, 20% faced login problems, and another 20% experienced issues with their news feeds and timelines.
The outage appears to be widespread, affecting multiple regions worldwide. Some users have also reported similar disruptions on Instagram, another Meta-owned platform.
As of the report's publication, Meta has not yet released an official statement regarding the cause of the cause of the outage or a timeline for a full resolution.

headline: Users face issues as Facebook goes down suddenly
summary: Millions of users worldwide are experiencing connectivity issues and outages as the social media giant's services are disrupted.
details: Facebook is currently experiencing a widespread outage, leaving millions of users unable to access the platform.
Users across various regions have reported that the platform is not loading, and some are unable to log in to their accounts.
The outage has caused significant disruption for individuals and businesses that rely on the Facebook ecosystem for communication and communication.
While the company has not yet provided an official statement on the cause of the cause of the outage, users are taking to other platforms to report the problem.
Technical teams are likely working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible to restore full service to all users.
